description: Defines an abstract class 'ComparisonNode' representing a generic comparison operation with type, property, and value, used as part of an AST for RQL predicates in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ComparisonNode
classes.description: An abstract class representing a comparison node with a comparison type, property, and value, implementing the Node interface.
